hadith.chapterTitle: Excellence of Generosity and Spending in a Good cause with Reliance on Allah
hadith.body:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah, the Exalted, says, 'Spend, O son of Adam, you will also be spent upon."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim].

hadith.chapterTitle: - باب الكرم والجود والإنفاق فى وجوه الخير ثقة بالله تعالى
hadith.body: - وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ “قال الله تعالى‏:‏ انفق يا ابن آدم ينفق عليك” ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

hadith.chapterTitle: Kelebihan Sifat Dermawan dan Berinfak di Jalan Allah dengan Bertawakal kepada Allah
hadith.body: Abu Hurairah (Semoga Allah meredainya) melaporkan: Rasulullah (ﷺ) bersabda, "Allah yang Maha Tinggi berfirman, 'Berinfaklah wahai anak Adam, nescaya kamu juga akan diberi (rezeki)'." [Al-Bukhari dan Muslim].
